title: Kitten Plays With a Dog On the Stairs and Takes a Tumble
description:
Some pet games stay perfectly balanced right up until they do not.

A kitten and a dog face each other on a staircase, pawing and shifting around as they play.

The kitten moves along the step edge near the dog, then loses its footing and drops off the stairs.

The moment turns from gentle back-and-forth to a quick reminder of how fast a small misstep can change the scene

It ends as a brief, unscripted beat in an otherwise calm playtime.
